# Source: Hamamatsu, from the series "Fifty-three Stations of the Tokaido (Tokaido gojusan tsugi)," also known as the Tokaido with Poem (Kyoka iri Tokaido)

This GameCore theme is derived from a **specific, real, public-domain work**—not a generated palette.

## Work

- **Title:** Hamamatsu, from the series "Fifty-three Stations of the Tokaido (Tokaido gojusan tsugi)," also known as the Tokaido with Poem (Kyoka iri Tokaido)
- **Artist / culture:** Utagawa Hiroshige 歌川 広重 Japanese, 1797-1858
- **Date:** c. 1837/42
- **Style:** Japanese (culture or style)
- **Classification:** woodblock print
- **Department:** Arts of Asia
- **AIC artwork ID:** 4371
- **Artwork page:** https://www.artic.edu/artworks/4371
- **Public-domain image:** https://www.artic.edu/iiif/2/cef4e5df-a749-090b-b897-7d5f40654685/full/400,/0/default.jpg
- **Research category:** Japanese Woodblock

## Extracted source palette

`#E8E8C8, #484838, #88A898, #E8D898, #B8A888, #D8C8B8, #685848, #989878`

The image was downsampled deterministically and quantized to a four-bit-per-channel histogram.
Colors were ranked by pixel population and de-duplicated by RGB distance. No random values are used.

## Semantic adaptation

- `background`: `#25251D`
- `surface`: `#3E3E37`
- `on_surface`: `#F8F8F6`
- `primary`: `#E8D898`
- `on_primary`: `#0C0C0E`
- `secondary`: `#685848`
- `surface_variant`: `#3E3E37`
- `on_surface_variant`: `#F8F8F6`
- `outline`: `#60605A`
- `error`: `#E8D898`
- `on_error`: `#0C0C0E`

- Font: `serif` (chosen from source style/classification)
- Corner radius: `6dp` (chosen from source object/design classification)
- Body contrast: background `14.51:1`, surface `10.13:1`
- Variant contrast: `10.13:1`
- Control contrast: `13.69:1`

Backgrounds retain a source hue but are toned toward neutral only when needed to ensure body text is
at least 7.0:1. The primary action remains an extracted source color and its ink is chosen
for at least 4.5:1.
